name: clean
title: Baseline: clean ownership
fix_goal: Use this as the reference shape: acquire resources, check errors, release every owned resource exactly once.
fix_steps: Notice descriptors are initialized to -1 before cleanup.
Notice owned pointers are freed on both success and failure paths.
Compare later labs against this cleanup shape.
lesson: A well-structured p101 program closes descriptors, frees allocations, and keeps ordinary and injected-error paths clean.
